description.value: Cumberland Grind is an espresso and smoothie bar situated in Cumberland, a small Vancouver Island village with a strong mountain biking culture and a reputation as a cycling destination. The café offers both takeout and outdoor seating, making it a natural pit stop for riders rolling through the Comox Valley. It accepts a wide range of payment methods including tap and mobile pay.
